outlooks.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM THE SOUTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS TO THE TENNESSEE VALLEY. DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE...WITH AN ENHANCED RISK OF THESE HAZARDS OVER THE OZARK PLATEAU.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL PERSIST OVER NEW ENGLAND...WHILE AN UPSTREAM LOW-AMPLITUDE IMPULSE OVER THE NRN PLAINS DAMPENS AS IT TRACKS TOWARDS THE UPPER GREAT LAKES. A MID-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE WILL REMAIN ANCHORED THROUGH CNTRL PARTS OF TX. BETWEEN THESE FEATURES...A BELT OF MODERATE TO STRONG MID-LEVEL W/NWLYS WILL BE PREVALENT FROM THE SRN HIGH PLAINS TOWARDS THE TN VALLEY. AT THE SURFACE...A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT WILL BE MODULATED BY OVERNIGHT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW INTO THE D1 PERIOD. THIS FRONT SHOULD BE INVOF THE CAROLINAS TO MID-SOUTH TO SRN TX PANHANDLE IN THE LATE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: KS/OK TO TN/AL
sections.text: THE E/SEWD EVOLUTION OF AN INTENSE CLUSTER OF STORMS CURRENTLY OVER E-CNTRL CO APPEARS TO BE THE PRIMARY FORECAST CHALLENGE FOR D1. WITH CONTINUED NWWD ADVECTION OF MIDDLE 60S TO LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS PRESENT NEAR THE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT AMIDST STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...THIS CONVECTION SHOULD BE MAINTAINED WITHIN A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. IN CONJUNCTION WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA...ROBUST EFFECTIVE SHEAR SHOULD AID IN UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS WITH BOWING SEGMENTS BY 12Z/THU INVOF ERN KS. THIS WOULD POSE A LINGERING ENHANCED RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS...BUT PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER LOW-LEVEL WINDS WITH ERN EXTENT SHOULD RESULT IN MCS INTENSITY WANING DURING THE LATE MORNING. RENEWED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR DOWNSTREAM OVER THE MID-SOUTH TO TN VALLEY DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH ORGANIZED SEVERE RISK GENERALLY CONFINED TO THE FRINGE OF THE PLAINS EML AND MID-LEVEL NWLYS AOA 30 KT. SW OF THE MORNING MCS OVER THE SRN PLAINS...ROBUST DIURNAL HEATING WILL OCCUR WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARMING THROUGH THE 90S TO NEAR 105. THIS SHOULD YIELD PRONOUNCED DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG THE REMNANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE FRONTAL BOUNDARY. MODEST LOW-LEVEL ISENT

sections.title: SRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING WITHIN A CONTINUED LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME OVER ERN CO. A BELT OF MODERATE TO STRONG MID-LEVEL WLYS WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH A RISK OF LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY FORM N OF THE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT ON THU NIGHT AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS ACROSS W TX. LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY RISK WITH THIS ACTIVITY. ..GRAMS/DEAN.. 06/05/2014

outlooks.summary: WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE TODAY FROM SOUTHEAST KANSAS AND NORTHEAST OKLAHOMA THROUGH SOUTHERN PARTS OF MISSOURI AND NORTHERN ARKANSAS INTO WESTERN TENNESSEE. ELSEWHERE...ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A QUASI-ZONAL MIDLEVEL FLOW REGIME WILL PERSIST ACROSS THE NRN/CNTRL CONUS TO THE N OF AN ELONGATED ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER NWRN MEXICO INTO TX. WITHIN THIS BROADER-SCALE PATTERN...A MULTI-STREAM SHORT-WAVE TROUGH WILL TRACK FROM THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES...OH VALLEY...AND MID SOUTH. FARTHER W...A NUMBER OF LOW-AMPLITUDE PERTURBATIONS WILL PROGRESS THROUGH THE WRN STATES TOWARD THE GREAT PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...A MIGRATORY LOW JUST OFF THE NJ COAST WILL DEVELOP NEWD WHILE A TRAILING COLD FRONT SETTLES SWD THROUGH THE MID ATLANTIC STATES AND CAROLINAS. THE WRN EXTENSION OF THIS FRONT WILL REMAIN QUASI-STATIONARY FROM THE TN VALLEY TO LOW PRESSURE OVER NRN OK...THOUGH SOME FLUCTUATION OF ITS POSITION WILL OCCUR DUE TO CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING TSTMS. ELSEWHERE...A TROUGH WILL ADVANCE THROUGH THE ERN DAKOTAS INTO WRN MN BEFORE STALLING. UPSTREAM...A COLD FRONT WILL PUSH SEWD FROM THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE PROVINCES INTO THE NRN PLAINS.

sections.title: OZARK PLATEAU TO MID SOUTH TODAY INTO THIS EVENING
sections.text: AN INTENSE MCS COMPRISED OF SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES IS IN PROGRESS AS OF 12Z OVER ERN KS WITH AN OBSERVED SYSTEM MOTION OF 290/45 KT. REGIONAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT THIS MCS IS SITUATED ON THE NERN FRINGE OF A STRONG CAP SITUATED AT THE BASE OF THE EML WHICH WILL LIMIT A SWWD EXPANSION OF STORMS TODAY. LATEST CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE REMAINS IN GOOD AGREEMENT IN SUGGESTING THAT THIS BOW ECHO WILL CONTINUE SEWD ACROSS SRN MO/NRN AR INTO WRN TN/NRN MS ALONG THE STATIONARY SURFACE FRONT. GIVEN THE WELL-ESTABLISHED COLD POOL...40-50+ KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...AND THE CONTINUED INFLUX OF A VERY MOIST AND MODERATE-STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS...EXPECT WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL TO CONTINUE ALONG THE MCS TRACK. LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE. FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE...SEE MCD 833. ...CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS OF KS/OK THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT... THE MAINTENANCE OF AN ELY LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME AND THE POSSIBLE INFLUENCE OF RIDGE-CRESTING VORTICITY MAXIMA ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT OFF THE CO FRONT RANGE...PERHAPS AS FAR S AS THE RATON MESA. SIMILAR TO WEDNESD

sections.title: ERN CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: SCATTERED AFTERNOON TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS ANTICIPATED TO OCCUR ALONG DEVELOPING SEA BREEZE FRONTS...A LEE TROUGH...AS WELL AS THE SWD-MOVING SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT. THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J PER KG/ WILL PROMOTE VIGOROUS UP/DOWNDRAFTS WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS HAIL. MARGINAL VERTICAL SHEAR MAGNITUDES ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION AND THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER EVENT.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY INTO MID MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: RESIDUAL BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO LOWER 60S COUPLED WITH COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J PER KG/ IN LOCATIONS THAT RECEIVE STRONGER HEATING AHEAD OF THE SURFACE TROUGH. AND WHILE THE PRIMARY ZONE OF FORCING FOR ASCENT/DCVA IS EXPECTED TO SHIFT TO THE EAST OF THE SURFACE TROUGH BY AFTERNOON...SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL UPLIFT ALONG THE BOUNDARY SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT WIDELY SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN THE CO-LOCATION OF A MODESTLY SHEARED KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT...THE SETUP MAY FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND/OR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. ..MEAD/ROGERS.. 06/05/2014

outlooks.summary: WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE TODAY FROM SOUTHERN MISSOURI AND NORTHERN ARKANSAS INTO WESTERN TENNESSEE. ELSEWHERE...ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND ALONG THE MID-ATLANTIC SEABOARD.

sections.title: MO/AR TO TN VALLEY
sections.text: ONGOING FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS MOVING E-SEWD AT 50KT APPEARS TO HAVE REACHED OR PERHAPS EVEN PASSED MATURITY WITH RECENT IR IMAGERY DEPICTING A GRADUAL WARMING OF THE COLDEST CLOUD TOPS NEAR THE CORE OF THE DEEP CONVECTION. HOWEVER...EXTENSIVE COLD POOL AND ASSOCIATED PRESSURE PERTURBATIONS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS SYSTEM WILL MAINTAIN FORCED MESOSCALE ASCENT FOR CONTINUED UPDRAFT GENERATION...ESPECIALLY WHERE THIS FORCING OCCURS COINCIDENT WITH PRE-EXISTING QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT SITUATED FROM NERN AR ESEWD TO THE TN VALLEY. CONTINUED STRONG DESTABILIZATION ON THE NERN EDGE OF PRONOUNCED ELEVATED MIXED LAYER ACROSS OK/SRN AR SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO INTENSE STORMS ON THE LEADING EDGE OF THE SEVERE MCS WITH DAMAGING WIND SWATH LIKELY TO CONTINUE ESEWD FROM NERN AR TO AT LEAST WRN TN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. REF LATEST WWS AND MCDS FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS ABOUT THIS SEVERE WEATHER SYSTEM AS IT PERSISTS INTO THE AFTERNOON AND MOVES TOWARD THE TN VALLEY. LATEST NAM INDICATES POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT IN THE WAKE OF THE MCS...FROM KS INTO OK LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT....AND ALSO ACROSS SERN NEB/NERN KS AND INTO MO LATER THIS AFTERNOON. IN KS/OK...OUTFLOW-REINFORCED REMNANT

sections.title: NC/SC
sections.text: HAVE INCREASED THE PROBABILITY FOR SCATTERED DAMAGING TSTM WINDS ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS FOR THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. AS WEAK COLD FRONT SETTLES SOUTH TO NEAR VA/NC BORDER AREA...LEE/THERMAL TROUGHING WILL OCCUR ALONG AND EAST OF THE PIEDMONT. A MOIST AND INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS CHARACTERIZED BY WEAK INHIBITION AND STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD SUPPORT SCATTERED STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT AMIDST MLCAPE AOA 1500 J/KG. WHILE EFFECTIVE VERTICAL SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG AT 20-30KT...SOME LARGE SCALE SUPPORT MAY BE PROVIDED BY WEAK HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITH PASSAGE OF A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE NORTHEAST. MULTICELLULAR CONVECTION SHOULD BE MOST FOCUSED NEAR FRONT/LEE TROUGH INTERSECTION FROM SERN VA INTO NERN NC...ALONG AND AHEAD OF WEAK LEE TROUGH OVER ERN NC...AND NEAR BAY/SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES FROM ERN NC INTO NERN SC. DAMAGING WET MICROBURST WINDS SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH STORMS WEAKENING AFTER SUNSET.

sections.title: CO FRONT RANGE TO ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: THE MAINTENANCE OF AN ELY LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME AND THE POSSIBLE INFLUENCE OF RIDGE-CRESTING VORTICITY MAXIMA ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT OFF THE CO FRONT RANGE...PERHAPS AS FAR S AS THE RATON MESA. SIMILAR TO WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON/EVENING...STORMS WILL PROGRESS EWD/SEWD INTO A PROGRESSIVELY MORE MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WHERE MLCAPE WILL APPROACH 1000-1500 J/KG. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS VEERING TO WLY AT 40-50 KT IN THE MID-TROPOSPHERE...THE SETUP WILL FAVOR SUPERCELL MORPHOLOGIES WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY TO MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: RESIDUAL BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO LOWER 60S COUPLED WITH COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J PER KG/ IN LOCATIONS THAT RECEIVE STRONGER HEATING AHEAD OF THE SURFACE TROUGH. sections.title: ERN MT TO WRN ND
sections.text: ADDED LOW PROBABILITY WIND AND HAIL THREATS TO THESE AREAS AS A STRONG COLD FRONT SPREADS EAST OUT OF THE CANADIAN PRAIRIES AND AIDS SCATTERED STORM INITIATION AMIDST A WEAKLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS FROM LATER AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. WHILE FORCING ALONG THE FRONT WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW STRONG STORMS...LACK OF STRONGER DESTABILIZATION SHOULD LIMIT A MORE SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. ..CARBIN/SCHNEIDER.. 06/05/2014

outlooks.summary: WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM THE MID-SOUTH TO NORTHERN GEORGIA. ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORMS...SOME SEVERE...ARE POSSIBLE ALONG THE MID-ATLANTIC SEABOARD INTO THE EARLY EVENING. MEANWHILE...ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN PLAINS TO EASTERN PART OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS.

sections.title: ERN NEB/ERN SD/WRN IA/WRN MN/SERN ND
sections.text: NUMEROUS SMALL BUT OCCASIONALLY INTENSE CONVECTIVE UPDRAFTS HAVE DEVELOPED AND PERSISTED WITHIN THE WEAK SFC TROUGH CROSSING THE NRN PLAINS FROM ERN DAKOTAS AND NERN NEB INTO WRN MN AND NWRN IA THIS AFTERNOON. AIR MASS ALONG AND WEST OF EARLIER CLOUD BAND ASSOCIATED WITH AN UPPER TROUGH HAS DESTABILIZED SUFFICIENTLY TO SUSTAIN THESE CELLS AMIDST POCKETS OF STRONGER SHEAR ON THE ORDER OF 24-35KT. STEEP DEEP-LAYER LAPSE RATES RESULTING FROM MID/UPPER COLD POOL AND STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING HAVE SUPPORTED A NUMBER OF HAIL REPORTS SO FAR. WITH GREATEST INFLUENCE ON THIS AFTERNOON DEVELOPMENT LIKELY BEING DIURNAL HEATING...EXPECT LOCAL SEVERE HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL TO DIMINISH QUICKLY AFTER SUNSET LATER THIS EVENING. ..CARBIN/PETERS.. .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 302 PM CDT THU JUN 05 2014/

sections.title: TN/NRN MS/NRN AL/NRN GA
sections.text: THE MODERATE RISK AREA HAS BEEN SHIFTED TO THE ESE TO INCLUDE PARTS OF SRN TN...FAR NERN MS...NRN AL AND NRN GA. A LONG-LIVED... WELL-DEFINED FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN A MOVEMENT TOWARD THE ESE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING ACROSS THE MODERATE RISK. ALTHOUGH IR IMAGERY INDICATED CLOUD TOPS HAVE BEEN WARMING IN THE WAKE OF THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...RECENT TIME-LAPSE /SINCE 1830Z/ IN IR IMAGERY SHOWED NEW COOLING TOPS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE MCS OVER WRN TN. THIS LATTER TREND SUGGESTS THIS MCS IS BEGINNING TO INGEST THE HIGHER THETA-E AIR AND MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY RESIDING FROM THE MID-SOUTH /NRN MS AND WRN TN/ INTO GA. THE ENVIRONMENT WITHIN THIS CORRIDOR...INCLUDING THE MODERATE RISK AREA...WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...GIVEN THE RETURN OF GREATER MOISTURE /PW EXCEEDING 1.75 INCHES/ AND ONGOING SURFACE HEATING CONTRIBUTING TO MUCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG. THESE THERMODYNAMIC FACTORS COMBINED WITH 50-70 KT OF WLY MID-LEVEL WINDS ATTENDANT TO THE MCV SUPPORTS A CONTINUED THREAT FOR STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS WITH SOME SIGNIFICANT GUSTS TO AROUND 70 KT ACROSS THE MODERATE RISK.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND ERN GA
sections.text: SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED A REMNANT MCV MOVING SEWD ACROSS ERN GA INTO SRN SC. ASCENT WITH THIS FEATURE IN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A FEW ADDITIONAL PULSE-TYPE...STRONG-SEVERE STORMS. GIVEN THESE FACTORS...THE SLIGHT RISK AREA HAS BEEN EXTENDED SWD.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: THE FORECAST ISSUED AT 1632Z REMAINS ON TRACK FOR THE REST OF THE DAY 1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK. ..PETERS.. 06/05/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1132 AM CDT THU JUN 05 2014/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIALLY WIDESPREAD WIND DAMAGE...IN ADDITION TO SOME SEVERE HAIL...WILL REMAIN A CONCERN THROUGH THE MORNING WITH A MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM MOVING ACROSS EASTERN KS/NORTHEAST OK INTO MUCH OF WESTERN/SOUTHERN MO AND NORTHERN AR. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCHES 227/228 CONTINUE UNTIL 15Z/18Z RESPECTIVELY. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS LIKELY TO BE NEEDED ACROSS ADDITIONAL PARTS OF SOUTHERN /AND POSSIBLY WESTERN/ MO AND NORTHERN AR. A CATEGORICAL UPGRADE TO MODERATE RISK WILL OCCUR WITH THE 13Z UPDATE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A VERY WELL-ORGANIZED SEVERE MCS/BOW ECHO WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHEAST KS/MUCH OF NORTHEAST OK INTO SOUTHERN MO/NORTHERN AR THIS MORNING. THIS MCS IS ASSOCIATED WITH A NOTABLE SURFACE PRESSURE FALL/RISE COUPLET WHILE THRIVING IN A MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT NEAR/NORTH OF A SURFACE BOUNDARY ACROSS THE REGION. THE MCS IS ALSO LIKELY BE AIDED BY AN MCV/REAR INFLOW JET WITH 50+ KT WINDS AS LOW AS 4KM AGL AS PER THE WICHITA WSR-88D VWP. WARM SECTOR MLCAPE IS AS HIGH AS 2000 J/KG ACROSS NORTHEAST OK/SOUTHWEST MO INTO AR...WHICH WILL BE INCREASINGLY REALIZED AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS. WITH A RELATIVELY MOISTURE-RICH ENVIRONMENT ALREADY IN PLACE /SURFACE DEWPOINTS NEAR 70 F/...EARLY DAY VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOW THAT THE MCS-PRECEDING AIR MASS WILL INDEED STEADILY HEAT THROUGH THE MORNING FROM FAR EASTERN OK INTO AR/SOUTHERN MO. FARTHER NORTH...AS THE MCS CONTINUES TO UNDERGO AN ASYMMETRIC SQUALL LINE-TYPE EVOLUTION...THE POTENTIAL FOR NORTH-SIDE COMMA HEAD VORTICES CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE MAY INCREASE POTENTIALLY AS FAR NORTH AS ROUGHLY THE I-70 CORRIDOR. A 53 KT GUST WAS RECENTLY MEASURED AT SALINA KS AS OF AROUND 1210Z. ADDITIONALLY...WAKE LOW RELATED WINDS TO SEVERE-CALIBER LEVELS MAY BE POSSIBLE IN ACCORDANCE WITH PRONOUNCED PRESSURE FALLS /8-9MB PER 2HR FALLS/ ACROSS CENTRAL KS WITH MCS-TRAILING EASTERLY WINDS. ..GUYER.. 06/05/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING STRAIGHT LINE WINDS ARE EXPECTED WITH SEWD-MOVING MCS AS IT TRACKS ALONG THE MO/AR BORDER INTO WRN TN/NRN MS. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON TO ACCOUNT FOR THESE TRENDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED...FAST-MOVING MCS IS PROGRESSING INTO SWRN MO WITH A NEW MCV FORMING JUST NORTH OF JLN. LEADING EDGE OF SQUALL LINE IS PROPAGATING SEWD IN EXCESS OF 60KT AND WILL APPROACH ERN EDGE OF WW 228 BY 1530Z. DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUE WITH THIS MCS WITH NUMEROUS MEASURED WIND GUSTS IN EXCESS OF 50KT. AT 1353Z WINDS GUSTED TO 56KT AT JLN. VERY WARM 700MB TEMPERATURES ARE NOTED ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS INTO CNTRL AR WITH VALUES BETWEEN 14-18C. THIS SHOULD LIMIT THE SWRN FLANK OF MCS. HOWEVER...STRONG ORGANIZED MCV OVER SWRN MO SHOULD INDUCE ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT AS IT TURNS SEWD ALONG SYNOPTIC FRONT...REINFORCED BY EARLY-MORNING CONVECTION ACROSS WRN TN. THIS CORRIDOR APPEARS TO HAVE THE GREATEST RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON. DIURNAL HEATING MAY ALLOW MCS TO TURN SWD ACROSS WRN TN INTO NRN MS ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF STRONG CAP. ..DARROW.. 06/05/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE WANING ACROSS WW229.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OLD MCV THAT DEVELOPED ACROSS NCNTRL KS EARLY THIS MORNING HAS TRACKED SOUTH OF THE KC METRO AREA TO JOHNSON COUNTY MO. WIND SPEEDS HAVE GENERALLY DECREASED IN THE WAKE OF THE MCS ACROSS THIS PORTION OF KS/MO AS COMPLEX OF STORMS HAS REGENERATED ALONG THE MO/AR BORDER...WELL SOUTH OF WW229. STRONGEST WAKE-LOW WINDS SHOULD BE NOTED ACROSS SRN MO THROUGH LATE MORNING. ..DARROW.. 06/05/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN AREAL COVERAGE SOUTH OF COLD FRONT ACROSS SERN VA INTO CNTRL/ERN NC. WIND/HAIL MAY BE NOTED WITH THIS ACTIVITY...POSSIBLY NECESSITATING A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEEPENING BOUNDARY LAYER THERMALS HAVE RECENTLY CONTRIBUTED TO ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS EAST OF RDU. STEEPEST LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE LOCATED ACROSS COASTAL CAROLINAS INTO SERN VA WHERE SFC-3KM VALUES ARE APPROACHING 8 C/KM. IT APPEARS CONVECTION SHOULD GRADUALLY INTENSIFY WITHIN STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY SUFFICIENT CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED MULTI-CELL UPDRAFTS. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL ARE EXPECTED ALONG/SOUTH OF COLD FRONT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE WARRANTED TO INCLUDE PORTIONS OF MIDDLE TN AND POSSIBLY NRN AL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED MCS IS PROGRESSING ALONG THE MO/AR BORDER AT ROUGHLY 50KT WITH THE APEX OF THE LEADING SQUALL LINE EXPECTED TO SURGE JUST NORTH OF THE MEM METRO AREA. NUMEROUS 50KT MEASURED WIND GUSTS HAVE BEEN NOTED WITH THIS PORTION OF THE SQUALL LINE. DOWNSTREAM...EAST-WEST BAND OF WARM ADVECTION CONVECTION EXTENDS ACROSS WRN TN AND IS SLOWLY INTENSIFYING. THIS SHOULD SERVE AS BAROCLINIC ZONE FOR AFOREMENTIONED MCS TO TRACK ALONG. WITH TIME ROBUST CONVECTION SHOULD PROPAGATE INTO MIDDLE TN AND WILL NECESSITATE A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. ..DARROW.. 06/05/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON NEAR THE SOUTH DAKOTA-IOWA BORDER SOUTHWARD INTO EASTERN NEBRASKA WILL POSE A THREAT FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON FROM WORTHINGTON MN SOUTHWESTWARD TO NEAR NORFOLK NE...AHEAD OF A SLOW MOVING NORTHERN PLAINS SHORTWAVE. MODEST UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP LAYER 0-6KM SHEAR OF 25-30KT COMBINED WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J.KG WILL SUPPORT MULTICELL STRUCTURES AND A MARGINAL SEVERE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. HAIL GUIDANCE BASED ON SHORT TERM RAP PFCS INDICATE POTENTIAL FOR 1-1.5 INCH HAIL WITH STRONGEST MORE ISOLATED STORMS. SOME STRENGTHENING OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS POSSIBLE LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS THE TROUGH AXIS APPROACHES THE AREA FROM THE WEST...BUT WEAK UNIDIRECTIONAL SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT OVERALL SEVERE RISK. 1800 UTC VWP AT SUX INDICATES SOME STRENGTHENING OF MID LEVEL FLOW...BUT RAP FCST INDICATES CURRENT 4-6KM MEAN WINDS REMAIN STEADY AT 30KTS UNTIL SHIFTING TO NW FLOW AFTER PASSAGE OF THE MID LEVEL TROUGH AXIS AND ASSOCIATED CONVECTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS WW231.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE HAS SHIFTED INTO THE BODY OF WW231 COINCIDENT WITH STRONGEST CONVECTION FROM NE-SW ACROSS THE COASTAL PLAINS. WHILE LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT...LATEST WDSSII DATA SUGGESTS HAIL GREATER THAN GOLF BALL SIZE IS NOTED WITH SEVERE STORM OVER BEAUFORT COUNTY NC. A CONTINUED SLOW UPWARD EVOLUTION IS EXPECTED OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS TSTMS PROPAGATE TOWARD THE COAST. ..DARROW.. 06/05/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS FORMING OVER COLORADO FRONT RANGE THIS AFTERNOON ARE EXPECTED TO SHIFT EASTWARD WITHIN MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CURRENTLY FORMING OVER THE COLORADO FRONT RANGE ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE OFF HIGHER TERRAIN AND POSE A LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT OVER EASTERN CO AND EXTREME NORTHEASTERN NEW MEXICO. MID LEVEL WESTERLY FLOW ATOP LOW LEVEL EASTERLY FLOW WILL RESULT IN 45-65 KT 0-6KM BULK SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG WILL LIKELY PRODUCE ISOLATED SUPERCELL STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. HAIL FORECAST GUIDANCE FROM 1800UTC NAM AND RECENT RAP PFCS SUGGEST SEVERE HAIL UP TO 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER. COMPARED TO YESTERDAY...LOW LEVEL MOISTURE WILL BE MORE LIMITED...BUT AGAIN...AN ISOLATED TORNADO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT WITH STRONG SUPERCELL STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH EARLY EVENING...AND A WATCH COULD BE REQUIRED. LARGE HAIL AND BRIEF TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE ERUPTED WITHIN A SHARP N-S ORIENTED SURFACE TROUGH...ALSO BENEATH A FAST-MOVING MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH WITH COOL POCKET ALOFT HELPING TO DESTABILIZE THE AREA. STORMS CURRENTLY RESIDE WITHIN THE SURFACE THETA-E AXIS...BOUNDED TO THE EAST BY OUTFLOW-REINFORCED COOL AIR. THEREFORE...AS THE UPPER TROUGH SHIFTS E...THERE SHOULD BE A GRADUAL DECREASE IN STORM COVERAGE THROUGH EVENING. HOWEVER...SEVERE WEATHER IS LIKELY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE ATLANTA METRO AREA MAY BE IMPACTED BY STRONG/SEVERE STORMS WITH THE RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING BY 01-02Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONSIDERABLE WEAKENING OF THE ONGOING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM HAS OCCURRED DURING THE PAST HOUR OR SO. SOUTHEASTWARD MOTION OF THE SURFACE COLD POOL APPEARS TO HAVE SLOWED AS IT ADVANCES INTO A PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER DEEP LAYER NORTHWESTERLY MEAN FLOW REGIME. WESTERLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF THE COLD POOL DOES NOT APPEAR OPTIMAL FOR SYSTEM MAINTENANCE. HOWEVER...THE GUST FRONT ENCOUNTERS THE WESTERN FLANK OF A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NEAR/ SOUTHEAST OF GADSEN AROUND 00Z...ENHANCED CONVERGENCE COULD STILL SUPPORT INTENSIFYING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. IF THIS OCCURS...IT SEEMS LIKELY TO SUBSEQUENTLY TAKE A MORE SOUTHEASTWARD TURN...JUST TO THE COOL SIDE OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHERE A MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIR MASS IS CONTRIBUTING MODERATELY LARGE CAPE. AT LEAST WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE ATLANTA METRO AREA MAY BE IMPACTED BY STORMS...WITH POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING BY 01-02Z. ..KERR.. 06/05/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS WITH MAINLY A HAIL THREAT PERSIST ACROSS ERN CO. AN INCREASING WIND THREAT COULD MATERIALIZE LATER THIS EVENING ACROSS THE WATCH AREA AS WELL AS POINTS E AND SE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HEATING AND UPSLOPE FLOW HAS LED TO A FEW SUPERCELLS PRODUCING HAIL OVER ERN CO. WITH RELATIVELY COOL/STABLE AIR OVER NERN CO AND NRN KS...CELLS ARE PROPAGATING IN A SEWD DIRECTION IN ORDER TO REMAIN WITHIN THE HIGHER THETA-E AIR MASS. LONG HODOGRAPHS CONTINUE TO FAVOR SUPERCELLULAR STORM MODE...WITH SOME SPLITTING NOTED BUT STILL FAVORING RIGHT MOVERS. WITH TIME...THESE PERSISTENT CELLS SHOULD CONTINUE TO PRODUCE MORE OUTFLOW...AND MERGERS AND UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS MIGHT OCCUR WITH AN INCREASING WIND THREAT. OTHER STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO AFFECT ERN NM AND WRN TX...AND ANY OUTFLOW FROM THOSE STORMS COULD EVENTUALLY MERGE WITH THE NRN ACTIVITY LATER TONIGHT OVER THE OK/TX PANHANDLES...WITH ANOTHER WATCH POSSIBLE. ..JEWELL.. 06/06/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE THIS EVENING WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL LIKELY. ADDITIONAL WATCHES MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERE HAIL STORMS CONTINUE TO MOVE SEWD ACROSS NERN NM...AND WILL AFFECT THE WRN OK PANHANDLE SOON WITH A HAIL AND WIND THREAT. FARTHER S...AN AREA OF LIFT/MOISTENING OVER CNTRL NM IS BEGINNING TO INTERACT WITH MORE UNSTABLE AIR OVER THE ERN PLAINS...WITH STORMS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP SOON IN THESE AREAS. STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND AMPLE CAPE WILL FAVOR BOTH HAIL AND WIND. TO THE S...VIGOROUS HIGH-BASED STORMS HAVE FORMED OVER SERN NM IN EXTREME HEAT. THESE CELLS SHOULD CONTINUE TO DEVELOP NEWD...WITH AN INCREASING CHANCE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. IN SUMMARY...STORMS ARE FORMING ON MANY FRONTS AROUND THE MCD AREA...AND A WATCH IS LIKELY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED CELLS CAPABLE OF MARGINAL HAIL WILL EVENTUALLY DWINDLE THIS EVENING...WITH NO FURTHER DEVELOPMENT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED CELLS CAPABLE OF MAINLY MARGINAL HAIL WILL CONTINUE SWD INTO NWRN IA THIS EVENING. THESE CELLS REMAIN IN THE INSTABILITY AXIS...BUT GRADUAL BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION SHOULD RESULT IN SHRINKING AND LEFTWARD-MOVING UPDRAFTS AS THEY DECOUPLE FROM THEIR SURFACE-BASED INFLOW SOURCE AND BECOME ORPHANED. ..JEWELL.. 06/06/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INTENSITY OF STORMS COULD BRIEFLY FLARE UP AGAIN ACROSS AND EAST SOUTHEAST OF THE AUGUSTA AREA BETWEEN NOW AND 03-04Z. HOWEVER... THE RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS SEEMS LOW/LOCALIZED ENOUGH THAT A NEW WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG/SEVERE STORMS THAT SPREAD ACROSS THE ATLANTA AREA HAVE GENERALLY DISSIPATED...WITH STRONGEST STORMS NOW OCCURRING IN A NARROW LINE ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE SURFACE COLD POOL APPROACHING THE AUGUSTA GA AREA. TRENDS IN LIGHTNING...RADAR AND SATELLITE DATA ALL INDICATE STEADY WEAKENING OF CONVECTIVE SYSTEM OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS. WESTERLY AMBIENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF THE COLD POOL IS NOT OPTIMAL...BUT GIVEN THE 35-40 KT EAST SOUTHEASTERLY PROPAGATION OF THE COLD POOL...SYSTEM RELATIVE INFLOW COULD STILL BE STRONG ENOUGH TO ALLOW AT LEAST A BRIEF FLARE UP OF STORMS ACROSS AND EAST SOUTHEAST OF AUGUSTA THROUGH THE 03-04Z TIME FRAME. THE REMNANT MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AIR MASS ACROSS THIS REGION...NEAR THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH...DOES NOT APPEAR IMPACTED SUBSTANTIALLY BY PRIOR CONVECTION...THOUGH INHIBITION IS PROBABLY INCREASING WITH GRADUAL SURFACE COOLING. ..KERR.. 06/06/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS EVENING...WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CELLS ARE FORMING NEAR A STATIONARY FRONT ACROSS NERN OK AND JUST N OF THE FRONT INTO SWRN MO AND NWRN AR. VERY STRONG INSTABILITY EXISTS IN THIS CORRIDOR...WHERE PRECIPITABLE WATER HAS INCREASED TO OVER 1.50 INCHES. THE 00Z LMN SOUNDING SHOWED 4000 J/KG MLCAPE ALONG WITH FAVORABLE WLY FLOW ALOFT FOR LONG LIVED HAIL STORMS. IN ADDITION...BOUNDARY LAYER DEEPENING HAS NEARLY ERODED THE CAP. ALTHOUGH FORCING FOR ASCENT IS WEAK...THE ROBUST MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY AS WELL AS FAVORABLE SHEAR SHOULD ACT ON THE DEVELOPING STORMS AND OVER TIME COULD RESULT IN SEVERE HAIL. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN SUCH INSTABILITY. AT THIS TIME...THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE ISOLATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WIND AND HAIL THREAT MAY STILL DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS FROM SERN CO INTO TX. A WATCH COULD BE NEEDED IF STORM COVERAGE BEGINS TO INCREASE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERE HAIL AND WIND HAS BEEN SCATTERED ACROSS MUCH OF ERN CO THIS EVENING...WITH MOST OF THE STORMS DYING ACROSS THE FAR ERN COUNTIES WHERE TEMPERATURES WERE COOLER. RECENTLY...A SEVERE STORM WAS ENTERING WRN KIOWA COUNTY CO BUT THE SAME DEMISE IS EXPECTED AS ITS PREDECESSORS. TO THE S...STORM ACTIVITY HAS QUIETED FOR THE MOMENT...BUT STRONG INSTABILITY REMAINS IN AN AXIS FROM ERN NM EWD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE AND INTO WRN OK. THIS IS ALSO WHERE A BOUNDARY LIES...WITH NELY 850 MB WINDS AT AMA AND SSELY 850 MB WINDS AT LBB PER VWPS. WITH SUCH STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT...ANY DEVELOPMENT COULD OCCUR RAPIDLY...AND A WATCH WOULD BE LIKELY IF THIS OCCURS. VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE EXPECTED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE...AND SHOULD MOVE EWD WHILE EXPANDING IN COVERAGE. RISK FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS MAY BECOME SUFFICIENT TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE DEVELOPING ATTM IN A W TO E BAND ALONG THE AMA LATITUDE...WITH RECENT INTENSIFICATION OF A FEW CELLS TO SEVERE LEVELS /A RECENT GUST OF 69 MPH HAS BEEN REPORTED/. THE STORMS ARE DEVELOPING NEAR/JUST N OF THE W-E SURFACE FRONT...AND WITH ELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW N OF THE FRONT BENEATH 35 TO 45 KT WLYS AT MID LEVELS...EWD PROPAGATION OF THE CONVECTION INTO A FAVORABLY UNSTABLE DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS ACROSS OK /IN EXCESS OF 2500 J/KG CAPE ABOVE THE CAPPING LAYER/ IS EXPECTED. GIVEN THE AFOREMENTIONED KINEMATIC/THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...EXPECT INTENSE/ROTATING STORMS...WITH LIKELIHOOD FOR UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A BOWING MCS. THUS...POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS IS EVIDENT IN ADDITION TO LARGE HAIL...WITH DEGREE OF THIS THREAT MODULATED BY DEGREE OF LINEAR ORGANIZATION STORMS CAN ACQUIRE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE ACROSS PORTIONS OF WW 236 AND 237 -- FROM THE TX PANHANDLE EWD INTO CENTRAL OK...WHERE LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND RISK CONTINUES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS A LARGE CLUSTER OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM NERN NM EWD INTO WRN OK...AND AN ISOLATED CELL OVER N CENTRAL OK. MEANWHILE...HINTS OF ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT OVER NWRN OK AND ADJACENT AREAS IS ALSO INDICATED IN RECENT RADAR IMAGES. ATTM...THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE MOVING EWD INVOF THE TX PANHANDLE/WRN OK BORDER...AND ARE MOVING INTO THE AXIS OF GREATEST INSTABILITY PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSES. GIVEN FAVORABLY STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ACROSS THIS AREA...SEVERE RISK CONTINUES -- WITH POTENTIAL FOR EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A BOWING LINE STILL POSSIBLE. MEANWHILE...THREAT HAS DIMINISHED ACROSS SWRN MO/NWRN AR AND INTO PARTS OF NERN OK...WITH THE LONE AFOREMENTIONED/WEAKENING CELL -- OVER PAYNE CO ATTM -- THE ONLY REMAINING STORM LINGERING FROM THE PRIOR AREA OF SEVERE CONVECTION. AS SUCH...WW 236 WILL LIKELY NOT REQUIRE EXTENSION/RE-ISSUANCE BEYOND ITS SCHEDULED 06/10Z EXPIRATION. ..GOSS.. 06/06/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM ACTIVITY CONTINUES ACROSS WRN OK WITH NEWLY DEVELOPED STORMS ALONG THE BORDER OF THE TX/OK PANHANDLES. SVR HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONTINUED WAA OVER BOUNDARIES LEFT IN THE WAKE OF EARLY CONVECTION ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE HAS LED TO A NEWLY DEVELOPED LINE OF TSTMS EXTENDING ALONG THE BORDER OF TX/OK PANHANDLES. THIS ELEVATED ACTIVITY HAS DEVELOPED IN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...100 MB MEAN MIXING-RATIO AROUND 13 G PER KG...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR GREATER THAN 40 KT. THIS TYPE OF ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT STRONG UPDRAFTS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR SVR HAIL AND...PER COORDINATION WITH WFO AMA...WATCH 237 WILL BE EXTENDED NWD TO COVER THE THREAT. RADAR TRENDS INDICATE THE STORMS MAY HAVE ALREADY REACHED PEAK INTENSITY AND DURATION OF THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO LAST FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS WRN/CNTRL OK CONTINUES TO SHOW A TENDENCY TOWARDS LINE SEGMENTS BUT STRUGGLES TO ORGANIZE SUFFICIENTLY FOR A SIGNIFICANT WIND THREAT. THERMODYNAMIC AND KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR OCCASIONAL SVR HAIL. STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE SEWD WHILE GROWING UPSCALE...POTENTIALLY ORGANIZING INTO A STRONG MCS. ..MOSIER.. 06/06/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
